{{Quote|We'll find him. Then we'll tell your people how it was done.|Unidentified Raptor to a stormtrooper|<ref name="IF" />}}
'''This Raptor''' served under [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] and was deployed with his [[Unidentified Raptor 1|partner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]] shortly after the [[Halmad campaign|battle]] that took place. He participated in the search for [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ton Phanan]] when his [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] crashed on the planet. His partner questioned the [[Unidentified stormtrooper (Halmad)|stormtrooper]] guarding the crash site for more information; and deeming the information inadequate, they mounted their [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] to conduct a search of their own. Just as they were about leave, they were shot to death by [[Garik Loran]]; another Wraith who was also searching for Phanan.<ref name="IF" />
